mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_cell_index ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, shelf_index_id BIGINT NOT NULL, shelve_id BIGINT NOT NULL, position_x INT NOT NULL, position_y INT NOT NULL, animal_cage_id BIGINT NULL, has_cage_box TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, cage_box_code VARCHAR(100) NULL, last_sync_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING', last_sync_error VARCHAR(500) NULL, synced_at DATETIME NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_cell_position (shelf_index_id, position_x, position_y), KEY idx_cell_shelve (shelve_id), KEY idx_cell_animal_cage (animal_cage_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO cage_cell_index ( shelf_index_id, shelve_id, position_x, position_y, animal_cage_id, has_cage_box, cage_box_code, last_sync_status, last_sync_error, synced_at ) VALUES
( #{item.shelfIndexId}, #{item.shelveId}, #{item.positionX}, #{item.positionY}, #{item.animalCageId}, #{item.hasCageBox}, #{item.cageBoxCode}, #{item.lastSyncStatus}, #{item.lastSyncError}, NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE animal_cage_id = VALUES(animal_cage_id), has_cage_box = VALUES(has_cage_box), cage_box_code = VALUES(cage_box_code), last_sync_status = VALUES(last_sync_status), last_sync_error = VALUES(last_sync_error), synced_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_cell_index WHERE shelf_index_id = #{shelfIndexId} ORDER BY position_y, position_x
SELECT * FROM cage_cell_index WHERE shelve_id = #{shelveId} ORDER BY position_y, position_x
SELECT DISTINCT shelve_id FROM cage_cell_index WHERE animal_cage_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT cci.*, si.room_id AS roomId, si.room_name AS room_name, si.shelve_name AS shelve_name, si.id AS shelf_index_id FROM cage_cell_index cci JOIN cage_shelf_index si ON si.id = cci.shelf_index_id WHERE cci.animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cci.shelf_index_id AS shelfIndexId, cci.shelve_id AS shelveId, cci.position_x AS positionX, cci.position_y AS positionY, cci.animal_cage_id AS animalCageId, cci.has_cage_box AS hasCageBox, cci.cage_box_code AS cageBoxCode, si.campus_name AS campusName, si.campus_id AS campusId, si.area_name AS areaName, si.floor_name AS floorName, si.floor_id AS floorId, si.room_name AS roomName, si.room_id AS roomId, si.shelve_name AS shelveName FROM cage_cell_index cci JOIN cage_shelf_index si ON si.id = cci.shelf_index_id WHERE cci.animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} LIMIT 1
